content.short: A fun family project creating NFTs while donating a portion to special causes and giving back to the Fire Animalz community.
content.description:
Vision: Bonding and having fun with the family supporting causes that we believe in through creation of digital art projects.

Mission: Helping people locally and in the Cardano community by giving to charity. May it be contagious, bringing people with us on this amazing journey.

Rookie Squad A - Genesis Collection: 99 wonderful pieces of digital art created on the Cardano blockchain by our family for you to enjoy! We are having so much fun creating these together. A portion of the proceeds goes to causes that we support and also goes back to the Fire Animalz community. Come join us in this epic adventure and feel good about the NFTs you hold!
